body.heading: Where in the world is Estonia?
paragraphs: Estonia is a country in Northern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Estonia is Tallinn.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Estonia is Estonian.

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Estonia is the euro. The euro is shared by many countries in Europe, so the same coins and notes work across borders.

body.heading: How big is Estonia?
paragraphs: Estonia covers about 45,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about half the size of Portugal.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Tallinn's Old Town is one of Europe's best-preserved medieval centres — towers, guild halls and a town hall square straight from a storybook.
Lahemaa mixes forest, bogs with boardwalks, fishing villages and grand manor houses on the Baltic coast — Estonia's nature in one park.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Estonia on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Estonia in one breath: a country in Northern Europe, capital Tallinn, where people speak Estonian and pay with the euro.
